body:
GitHub beamfall/corvint#772, filed by the owner 2026-10-11. Related: V1-1129 (#769, same pool acquire error mapping).

## Problem
`corvint-tasks pool acquire` refuses with `LOCK_TIMEOUT` ("preparation acquisition exceeded 30s") when several agents mutate the queue at once, even when a pool member is FREE. Unlike `release` (which accepts `--lock-wait SECONDS`, 1..300), `pool acquire` has no `--lock-wait` flag, so callers cannot ask it to wait for preparation admission.

## Observed
With ~7 concurrent agent sessions on one queue, 4 of 26 `pool acquire` calls in a 4-hour window returned `ERROR ["LOCK_TIMEOUT"]` (phase=registry or phase=queue). In one case a member was FREE the whole time; the session backed off for minutes before retrying, leaving the lane idle.

## Expected
`pool acquire` (and ideally every mutating command that goes through preparation admission: claim, renew, submit, pool confirm-safe, pool release) accepts `--lock-wait SECONDS` with the same semantics as `release`, and `--help` lists it.

## Workaround
Callers retry the same request id after a short sleep on `LOCK_TIMEOUT` (idempotent).
